title: AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.34241v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. translated_title: AdaGuard：一种支持用户自定义策略的自适应守护模型
translated_abstract: 守护模型为语言模型代理的安全部署提供支持，但固定的风险分类体系限制了其适应不同应用和任务需求的能力。在用户自定义策略下，检测违规行为需要同时理解适用的规则和代理的行为，因为相同的行为在不同策略下可能得到不同的判定结果。为支持这一能力的学习，我们提出了AdaptiveSafety数据集，包含10,939个训练样本和1,000个测试样本，覆盖含1至100条规则的策略。该数据集将来自多个来源的轨迹与策略反事实和行为反事实相结合，每个样本均配有解释说明及完整的违规规则集合。这些反事实揭示了会改变合规判定结果的变化，而结构化增强则为规则重排序和标识符重映射下的一致性提供了监督信号。基于这种监督，我们提出了（原文在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 提出AdaptiveSafety数据集与AdaGuard自适应守护模型，通过策略与行为反事实及结构化增强的监督，使守护模型能够根据用户自定义策略灵活判定语言模型代理行为的合规性。
en_tdlr: We introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, and AdaGuard, an adaptive guard model that detects violations of user-defined policies for language model agents.
